title: Projective Geometry: an interactive course
description: An interactive course on projective geometry. This release contains the inaugural lecture (first published on the web in 2001, web edition 2026) in English, French and Spanish, with twelve live constructions in CindyJS translated from the original Cinderella files. Online at https://alvarez-paiva.github.io/Projective-Geometry/

creators.affiliation: Laboratoire Paul Painlevé, Université de Lille, France
